new.physical_scope: Exact SI radar assignments for an inertial observer in complete vacuum under the ideal-clock and ideal-light assumptions of the radar protocol, with available ideal instantaneous reflectors and a clock calibrated to zero at the chart origin. Coordinates and rest distances have unit metre, T and proper/radar time have unit second, and c has unit metre per second. No finite-apparatus, material-medium, empirical-measurement or uncertainty claim is made.

calibration: Explicit tau(0)=0 selects the clock origin already intended by the exact numerical radar time T; offsets leave all geometric and elapsed-time conclusions unchanged.
